tripod.note: he is a fighter. he looks rough, but he will survive.

monsieur.note: he has some mealy bugs so i've added some mealy bug spray. hoping for a speedy recovery.

topper.note: this is my smartest child. she is thriving.

baby.note: he cannot grow more in this tiny planter, but i kinda want him to not grow up and stay my lil baby forever.

gin.note: she is an elegant lady, looking nice as ever

chomu.note: he is growing slowly, but looking very bright

chacko.note: he's the newest member -- potted from new money plant cuttings!

tripod.note: after months, there's finally a new leaf emerging! he has some mealy bugs, but i've been using the mealy bug spray, so let's see.

monsieur.note: the mealy bugs have gotten worse. i had to cut off some badly affected parts.

topper.note: she continues to live up to her name. i may need to repot her soon so she can grow more.

gin.note: she's looking rough cause i haven't been around to take care of my plants much.

chomu.note: he has grown quite a bit but has some mealy bugs, so i had to cut off a couple leaves.

chacko.note: chacko is also showing some growth and promise, but has sadly also been affected by mealy bugs.

mintu.note: he is a new mint plant and i'm excited to use it's leaves in my food!

piku.note: she is a new addition -- a gorgeous peace lily, and she will be rooming with me.

theodore.note: he's a new member, looks very wise and old.

tripod.note: there's a new leaf!!! lots of mealy bugs on it, but i'm killing them as and when i can.

monsieur.note: i had to cut off more leaves cause the mealy bugs had gotten to them :(

chomu.note: chomu has grown a little and i love this shade of green and the way the stem curls.

chacko.note: chacko is growing slowly but steadily.

mintu.note: mintu has given me yum leaves, but it dries up so quickly.

piku.note: piku is very dramatic. she doesn't get water for a day and all her leaves droop to the floor. she had too much pollen. she is currently not rooming with me.

theodore.note: theodore is not dramatic at all. he is always the same, so reliable.

tripod.note: the new leaf is bigger and brighter. there's still a few mealy bugs, but lesser than before.

monsieur.note: monsieur had to be euthanized because the mealy bugs had gotten to the last leaf. you've been with me for so long, it feels sad that you're no longer chilling in my balcony.

topper.note: she keeps growing. she's gotten huge!

gin.note: gin has a smol new leaf.

chomu.note: chomu is growing nicely. it's getting a bit more sun than it should though.

chacko.note: chacko had a growth spurt! he's dense and handsome.

piku.note: piku is doing well, she had a new peacy lily this month!
